row.title: SEED-SHIP-1: every seed is built, deployed and runs a year unattended
row.body: A seed is done only at stage autonomous: built, deployed (live-verified) and every one-year readiness check met; a proposal alone fails seedship --check and every seed short of autonomous has a Q-SEED item.
